description: Qualification row for the always-on listener APK (ai.elizaresearch.alphaphone.sense, docs/adr/0001-privileged-listener.md). It records which evidence classes exist for the listener and keeps it not device-qualified until gates G1-G6 have recorded evidence. scripts/verify-apks.mjs copies this state into the listener rows of apk-manifest.json; APK bytes never qualify it.

hostTests.scope: Plain-JVM policy, crash-loop, indicator-lease and SystemUI lease-client tests, and a javac type check of every listener source against the Android 36 platform jar (test/always-on-listener.test.mjs, test/listener-store-failure.test.mjs, test/aosp-listening-chip.test.mjs). Not an APK, Android, SystemUI or device run.

apkBuild.note: Historical developer build (debug and unsigned release). It predates the SystemUI indicator lease and is not a build of the current source; no listener APK row is admitted from it.

emulator.note: The listener is a privileged image-only app; an emulator install of a developer APK proves neither its privileges nor the SystemUI lease.

aospImage.note: No image with the staged listener and the patched SystemUI chip has been built or booted (gates G1-G2).

deviceAcceptance.note: No lock/AOD indicator, lease fail-closed, stop, coexistence, reboot, crash-loop, battery or thermal evidence on a Pixel 10a (gates G3-G6).

indicatorLease.note: Listener side (IndicatorLease, IndicatorLeaseProvider, ListeningService) and the SystemUI chip client (vendor/eliza/packages/os/android/sense/systemui/chip) exist in source with host tests only; see docs/aosp-listening-chip.md.
